race.comment: ASTERN EFFORT (6) is hard to look past after a decisive Ipswich CL1 win as favourite. His strong closing fourth to Gaultier two back adds depth and with improvement in store he can make it two on the bounce. SUPERALLOY (4) was was well below his best last time when always well back at Eagle Farm but he had been ticking along in much better order prior. Willing to forgive and Pozman reuniting with her claim is a positive. LUDIK (11) rates as one of the other main dangers with strong formlines around him. Drawn sticky but he drops back to a trip he relishes and keeps his regular hoop. STANDLEE (14) is holding his form well and gets another chance to flex some muscle over a favoured trip. Not underestimating. MISHANI PRINCE (12) hasn't been as effective of late but there's been some excuses. Draws well and holds peaks that can threaten.
